description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Notice declaring "Canadapura Children's Home" as an approved Charity
reasoning: This gazette notification involves the declaration of "Canadapura Children's Home" as an approved charity under Section 1(a)(ii) of the Fifth Schedule of the Inland Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017. While it mentions Minister Mangala Samaraweera, the core content is about implementing a specific provision of tax legislation (charity approval for tax purposes), making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
